programs.title: Three Levels, Matched to Your Child's Age
programs.lead: The BEC curriculum teaches conversation and grammar step by step — children learn through play, then move up a level with confidence.

activities.title: Learning Through Experience
activities.lead: Beyond regular classes, every BEC unit runs regular activities so children dare to use English in real life.

steps.title: Start Learning in 3 Steps
steps.lead: No long forms — find a unit, say hi to the admin, and your child can join a class right away.
steps.step1Text: Look up a BEC unit in your district or city and check its class schedule.
steps.step2Text: Contact the admin on WhatsApp to ask about fees, schedules and a trial class.
steps.step3Text: Your child takes a relaxed placement test, then joins the level that fits best.
